text.p: Investors should hold shares of Polish construction firm Mostostal Warszawa, which seemed fairly valued despite larger contracts that should come from cooperation with Exbud, Salomon Brothers said.
"We regard the company as fairly valued at the current price and rate the stock as a hold," Salomon Brothers in London said in a global equity research report dated July 14, 1997.
Salomon said Mostostal's alliance with builder Exbud, in which the two together would bid for and undertake larger contracts, was still to bear fruit. @

It said last year's share issue provided Mostostal capital for quick expansion during a period of high construction output growth in the country. Polish construciton output rose 26.4 percent in the January-May period, the report said.
